name: Full-waveform inversion and seismic imaging
applications: velocity model building for depth imaging
principle: An initial velocity model is updated iteratively until simulated seismic waveforms match recorded ones, producing a high-resolution subsurface velocity model that feeds migration and imaging. Compute needs are large and the method can fail when the starting model is too far off (cycle skipping); the SEG page read explains the geotechnical form of the method only.

process_steps.name: Start from an initial velocity model
Simulate waves and compare with recorded data
Update the model by minimising misfit and repeat

advantages: Resolves velocity detail that ray-based methods miss (general claim)
limitations: The sources read do not discuss cycle skipping, low-frequency needs or compute cost for oil and gas
